'''''Clipper''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that saw service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] at the [[Battle on the Frontier]].

The ''Clipper'' participated in the [[Attacks on Platform NL-1|Third Battle of the Pakuuni system]] and was destroyed in the battle, likely by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Clipper'' appears on [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] on Battle 3 Mission 6, but will only appear on the hardest difficulty.
